summary: Google DeepMind reports results of a randomized controlled trial in Sierra Leone measuring the impact of Gemini's Guided Learning feature on students' math progress, alongside release of a teacher training guide and an RCT methodology playbook.

practices.reason: The RCT playbook and pre-registered trial methodology could inform how other teams design impact evaluations, though it is education-outcome measurement rather than model evaluation.
practices.quote: are also releasing a playbook on our approach to RCTs with Fab AI to help others run faster, scalable studies aligned to their needs and contexts —
